Fitted expression curves of selected genes and their clustering

Source: R/progression_markers.R
compute_gene_curves.Rd

Predicts each gene's GAM curve on an even grid over the observed replication progress, z-scores the curves, clusters them (Ward's method on 1 - Pearson correlation) and summarises each curve.

Usage

compute_gene_curves(
  group_log_expr,
  model_data,
  genes,
  gam_basis_k = 10L,
  use_sample_covariate = FALSE,
  n_curve_points = 101L,
  n_clusters = 3L
)

Arguments

group_log_expr

Gene-by-cell log-normalised matrix of one group.

model_data

data.frame from prepare_group_inputs().

genes

Genes to compute curves for; unknown genes are ignored.

gam_basis_k

Upper bound of the smooth basis dimension.

use_sample_covariate

Add sample as a covariate when it has more than one level.

n_curve_points

Number of grid points.

n_clusters

Number of curve clusters (capped at the number of curves).

Value

A list with curves and curve_z (gene-by-grid matrices), rep_grid, clusters, hclust (NULL for a single curve), gene_order and curve_summary (gene, cluster, peak_rep_percent, late_minus_early). Genes whose curve is non-finite or constant are dropped. With no usable gene name the elements are NULL / empty.
